headlines.text: Germany invades Poland. Britain and France declare war on Germany.
The Battle Fleet shells the Polish troops at Danzig Corridor from the Baltic Sea.
Kampfgeschwader 1 bombs Polish Silesia. The bombing stopped 9% of Polish Silesia's output for a month: 2.9% of Polish production. 6 aircraft lost.
Kampfgeschwader 2 bombs Krakow. The bombing stopped 9% of Krakow's output for a month: 1.5% of Polish production. 4 aircraft lost.
Kampfgeschwader 3 bombs Lyon. The bombing stopped 8% of Lyon's output for a month: 1.1% of French production. The railway through Lyon is cut: no train runs until engineers relay it. 5 aircraft lost.
German troops close round Katowice: the city is under siege, with only its guard inside.
Juliusz Rommel is wounded at Lodz and will be out for 3 months.
Tadeusz Kutrzeba is taken prisoner with Army Poznan at Pomorze.
German troops close round Warsaw: the capital of Poland is under siege, with 4 corps inside.
German troops close round Krakow: the city is under siege, with one corps inside.
Wladyslaw Bortnowski is taken prisoner with Army Pomorze at Pomorze.
The Polish Navy declines battle in the Baltic Sea and makes for port.
The Red Army crosses into eastern Poland under the pact with Germany.
With no port left to it, the Polish Navy is scuttled.
With Warsaw under siege, Pursuit Brigade falls back to airfields in Lublin.
Bomber Brigade bombs Bohemia. The bombing stopped 4% of Bohemia's output for a month: 0.3% of German production. 3 aircraft lost.
Groupe de Bombardement 1 bombs Hamburg. The bombing stopped 5% of Hamburg's output for a month: 0.2% of German production. 3 aircraft lost.
No. 1 Bomber Group bombs Hamburg. The bombing stopped 5% of Hamburg's output for a month: 0.2% of German production. 3 aircraft lost.

Kampfgeschwader 1 bombs the defences of Warsaw. The bombs broke down 52% of the works of Warsaw: troops inside now fight 55% stronger, not 115%. The garrison lost 17% of its organisation. About 26% of the town guard is out of action. 10 aircraft lost.

Kampfgeschwader 2 bombs Krakow. The bombing stopped 9% of Krakow's output for a month: 2.9% of Polish production. The railway through Krakow is cut: no train runs until engineers relay it. 5 aircraft lost.
Warsaw falls to German forces.
Poland capitulates to Germany.
89,413 Polish troops surrender at Warsaw.
The month in the air and at sea, France: Hamburg bombed (3 aircraft lost).
The month in the air and at sea, United Kingdom: Hamburg bombed (3 aircraft lost).
The United States declares war on Mexico.

Third Army (2nd Division and 1st Cavalry Division) probes the line at Monterrey and finds Northern military zones. Their fieldworks are 0.5 months the worse for it: 0.5 months of work are left in them. It cost 635 men.
American troops close round Monterrey: the town is under siege, with only its guard inside.
Monterrey opens its gates to American troops without a fight.
American troops close round Sonora: the town is under siege, with only its guard inside.
The United States declares war on Canada.
American troops close round Toronto: the city is under siege, with only its guard inside.
American troops close round Ottawa: the capital of Canada is under siege, with only its guard inside.
War ends your trade with Canada.
War ends your trade with Mexico.
Kampfgeschwader 3 bombs Lyon. The bombing stopped 8% of Lyon's output for a month: 1.1% of French production. 4 aircraft lost.
Kampfgeschwader 1 bombs Paris by night. The bombing stopped 3% of Paris's output for a month: 0.8% of French production. 5 aircraft lost.
Kampfgeschwader 2 bombs Lorraine by night. The bombing stopped 3% of Lorraine's output for a month: 0.2% of French production. 7 aircraft lost.
The month in the air and at sea, France: Hamburg bombed (4 aircraft lost).
The month in the air and at sea, United Kingdom: Hamburg bombed (3 aircraft lost).
The factory district and the airfield outside Toronto now work for the United States, though the town holds: 0.5 a month to its treasury.
The harbour outside Sonora now works for the United States, though the town holds: 0.1 a month to its treasury.
It went the way the plan said, which never happens. Monterrey by nightfall, and hot food waiting when we got there.
headlines.by: A company commander, Third Army (2nd Division and 1st Cavalry Division)

headlines.text: Your secret service recruited agent Heron.
Your admirals sent the Atlantic Squadron into the Eastern Seaboard.
Fourth Army (3rd Division) has arrived at Monterrey.
